sources.snippet: Qwen3-.6B-GGUF Qwen3-.6B-GGUF is a 600-million parameter text-generation model from Alibaba (via Unsloth's quantized GGUF distribution). It supports switching between thinking mode (for reasoning/math/code) and non-thinking mode (for efficient dialogue), handles 100+ languages, and is Apache 2.0 licensed with no gating.

sources.title: Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3-.6B-GGUF is a 600 million parameter causal language model from Qwen designed for efficient local inference using the GGUF quantization format. This model combines two distinct operating modes—thinking mode for complex reasoning tasks and non-thinking mode for fast general dialogue—within a single architecture.
